sentences.s1: # Some AI Phone Calls Had Humans Behind the Scenes
sentences.s3: Behind a service that lets people ask AI to make phone calls, humans were actually making the calls.
sentences.s4: That kind of test was being carried out.
sentences.s5: The main player was Muse, Meta’s AI assistant.
sentences.s6: Muse can call businesses and stores in the United States to book haircuts, check whether items are in stock, and get price estimates from businesses.
sentences.s7: If AI can take care of troublesome phone calls, it seems very useful.
sentences.s8: However, in some tests of its calling feature, trained human contract workers made the calls instead of AI.
sentences.s9: They handled the conversations all the way to the end.
sentences.s10: The issue was not that humans made the calls themselves.
sentences.s11: The issue was how to tell users who was speaking.
sentences.s12: People who asked Muse to make a call might think that AI was making it.
sentences.s13: But in some cases, a human was speaking.
sentences.s14: And if this was not properly explained, users had no way to know whether they were talking to AI or a person.
sentences.s15: They were enjoying the convenience of AI, only to find a human on the other end of the call without realizing it.
sentences.s16: That was what was happening behind the scenes.
sentences.s17: Also, when user information was needed to continue a call, it might be shared unintentionally with contract workers at a call center.
sentences.s18: Meta employees pointed this out internally as a privacy concern.
sentences.s19: News reports also cited an employee’s report that human staff made inappropriate comments about race during calls to negotiate internet or cable fees.
sentences.s21: It would be wrong to apply it to all contract workers.
sentences.s22: A Meta executive admitted that starting the test without properly explaining it was a mistake.
sentences.s23: The company also restored the human concierge feature to the way it had been before, at least for now.
sentences.s24: The real challenge for AI phone calls is not just how they talk.
sentences.s25: It is whether they can honestly tell people who is on the other end of the call.
sentences.s26: The more useful a service is, the less it should hide the people working behind the scenes.
sentences.s27: The Muse case showed us this simple but important point.
sentences.s29: Some calls made through Meta’s AI assistant were actually handled by humans, without users being properly told.
